title: Portfolio
description: A set of holdings under simulation. Source of truth is the Pydantic model Portfolio in src/domain/portfolio/portfolio.py. Regenerated via `make contracts`.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes; see ADR-004.

baseCurrency.description: All weights are in this currency's units. Single currency in v1.

leverage.description: Gross exposure / NAV. Must equal 1.0 OR sum(weights) must equal 1.0 (Defining Q1.6 invariant).

holdings.description: Per-symbol positions. sum(weight) MUST equal 1.0 within ±1e-9.

weight.description: Position weight. Long-only assumed by default; negative values flagged.
